outline: 1388 Mental Shortcuts for Adding and Subtracting Integers

examples.solution_text:
(a) Multiply before subtracting.
$\begin{aligned}&\mathrel{\phantom{=}}5-3\times(-4)\\&=5-(-12)\\&=17\end{aligned}$
(b) Divide before adding.
$\begin{aligned}&\mathrel{\phantom{=}}-9+18\div(-3)\\&=-9+(-6)\\&=-15\end{aligned}$

(a) Work out the brackets first.
$\begin{aligned}&\mathrel{\phantom{=}}-4\times(2-7)\\&=-4\times(-5)\\&=20\end{aligned}$
(b) Work out the brackets, then divide, then add and subtract from left to right.
$\begin{aligned}&\mathrel{\phantom{=}}-8-(6+(-3))+12\div(-4)\\&=-8-3+12\div(-4)\\&=-8-3+(-3)\\&=-11+(-3)\\&=-14\end{aligned}$

examples.question_text:
Evaluate and explain the effect of the brackets.
(a) $(-4)^2\times3$
(b) $-4^2\times3$
examples.solution_text:
(a) The brackets make $-4$ the number being squared.
$\begin{aligned}&\mathrel{\phantom{=}}(-4)^2\times3\\&=16\times3\\&=48\end{aligned}$
(b) Square $4$ before applying the minus sign.
$\begin{aligned}&\mathrel{\phantom{=}}-4^2\times3\\&=-(4\times4)\times3\\&=-16\times3\\&=-48\end{aligned}$

examples.question_text:
(a) Evaluate $2-24\div(-4)\times(-2)$.
(b) A student writes $-3\times4+2\times(-5)=(-3\times4+2)\times(-5)=50$. Explain the error and find the correct answer.
examples.solution_text:
(a) Division and multiplication have equal priority, so work from left to right before subtracting.
$\begin{aligned}&\mathrel{\phantom{=}}2-24\div(-4)\times(-2)\\&=2-(-6)\times(-2)\\&=2-12\\&=-10\end{aligned}$
(b) Both multiplications must be done before the addition. The student grouped the addition with the first product.
$\begin{aligned}&\mathrel{\phantom{=}}-3\times4+2\times(-5)\\&=-12+2\times(-5)\\&=-12+(-10)\\&=-22\end{aligned}$
